content: What do you need from me right now?
We have to talk about the deadline. I know things are tight, but we need you to stay on this project.
I'm done bending over backwards. If you push me any further, I won't just quit, I'll make sure this company pays the price for every hour I put in.
Please don't say that. We value your work and want to find a way to make this manageable.
It's too late for negotiations. Cross me one more time, and I won't hesitate to expose everything I've seen here. Believe me, it won't be pretty.
I don't want it to get to that. What can we do to fix this? I'm willing to listen.
Fix it by respecting my limits. Otherwise, I'll walk, and trust me, losing me is the least of your problems.
Alright, I hear you. Let's sit down tomorrow and agree on new terms.
Good. Because if this happens again, I won't just leave, I'll make sure the fallout hits hard. Don't test me.
